subject.title: fix(text): strip MiniMax marker from channel replies

question: Should this PR wait for an after-fix official MiniMax or MiniMax Portal live run, or should a maintainer explicitly override that proof requirement after inspecting the stream tests and provider contract?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and well tested, but only a maintainer can accept the remaining delivery risk without observing the changed official-provider runtime path.

options.title: Capture official-provider proof
options.body: Run an official MiniMax or MiniMax Portal tool-using reply through Telegram or another real channel and provide redacted after-fix transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs.

options.title: Override after inspection
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the unit and source evidence if official-provider credentials are unavailable and they are comfortable owning the residual stream-delivery risk.

recommendation.title: Capture official-provider proof
recommendation.body: Run an official MiniMax or MiniMax Portal tool-using reply through Telegram or another real channel and provide redacted after-fix transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs.

likelyOwner.reason: They identified the ownership issue, reviewed the prior head, and are already assigned to this PR.
